responsibility: Runs the interprocedural identical code folding pass over functions and read-only variables. It builds semantic-item summaries, hashes and partitions them into congruence classes, compares candidates with the GIMPLE checker, merges equivalent symbols, and performs the follow-up point-to and alias fixups needed after folding.
same_name_distinction: Implements the top-level IPA identical code folding pass: it builds semantic items and congruence classes, drives hashing/refinement, invokes the GIMPLE comparator from gcc/ipa-icf-gimple.c, performs symbol merges, and fixes points-to information afterward. Unlike gcc/ipa-icf.h, it is the pass driver and merge logic, not the optimizer class/data-model declarations.
